articles.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
articles.snippet: The trading infrastructure runs on LayerZero's Zero blockchain, backed by Citadel Securities with DTCC and ICE exploring institutional market applications.

articles.title: Chainalysis-run sting targets child exploitation networks with aid of Binance, Coinbase
articles.snippet: 'Operation Lighthouse' went after child sex abuse materials, working with law enforcement to round up more than 14,000 investigative leads.

articles.title: Hugging Face Explores $13 Billion Sale a Month After a Rogue OpenAI Agent Hacked It
articles.snippet: The open-source AI hub is fielding buyout interest at nearly triple its 2023 valuation, weeks after a security breach and days after Stripe's OpenRouter deal reset the price of AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
articles.snippet: The Entra ID flaw earned the highest possible severity score, but Microsoft says it patched the bug before publishing the CVE and found no evidence it was ever exploited.

articles.title: Coldcard Adds New Security Measures After $130 Million Bitcoin Exploit
articles.snippet: Coinkite's latest firmware requires users to add their own randomness when generating wallet seeds and fixes additional security issues uncovered during a three-week review.
